NOT_AVAILABLE, never inferred: C A S I fundamentals and base-stage count. market_gate DELEGATED: every SUPPORT is void unless the index is in a confirmed uptrend.

answers.text: "flow engine sees no distribution". `subcomponents.flow.skew_score` 0.0 puts volume on down days and `subcomponents.flow.cmf` 0.02 closes mid-range: thin buying. `day_vol` 1.05 is far under the 1.40 breakout test (C16). I drop the divergence half (`subcomponents.energy.exhaustion_score` 10.0). W LH but HL, D HH/HL, H1 LH/LL: no decisive push. Stand.

"day_vol 1.05 clears my 1.0 floor". My floor is 1.40, not 1.0: a breakout needs +40% over the 20-day average (C16); 1.05 is +5%. `flow` 71.1 is advisory for me and `subcomponents.flow.skew_score` 0.0 says up-volume is absent. W LH but HL, D HH/HL at the Creek, H1 LH/LL: price passes, volume fails. Stand.

"IN-LINE does not hold". `subcomponents.structure.rs_vs_spy` 5.79 is a 3-month figure; my L test is `rs_leadership` on down-day outperformance: downday 0.17 is under the +0.25 LEADER line. `subcomponents.structure.base_days` 11.0 is AQE's sweet spot but a cup needs 7-8 weeks (C12), so `subcomponents.structure.base_score` 15.0 does not count for me. W LH/LL. Stand.

"A reclaim, not a breakout". Agreed, so there is no pivot break to buy: `day_vol` 1.04 is under 1.40 and my method buys breakouts only. `mp` 65.0 with `mp_accel_state` 2 (DECELERATING) and `subcomponents.structure.rs_accel` -13.02 say the lead is eroding. W LH but HL, D red bar 3.2% under the high, H1 LH/LL. Stand.

"day_vol 1.04 clears my 1.0 floor". My floor is 1.40 (C16); 1.04 is +4%. A quiet back-up is a handle (C15) only if a break then comes on volume; none yet. `energy` 82.4 and `subcomponents.energy.squeeze_score` 12.5 give the coil, but `structure` 63.2 stays modest. W LH but HL, D 1.8% under swing high. Stand.

"above normal at a high, not a failure". +9% over the 20-day average is not +40% (C16): a breakout nobody bought. Divergence count is advisory for me too; I drop it. `structure` 76.8, `mp` 96.0 and W D H1 HH/HL confirm the leader, never disputed. I buy the day `day_vol` reaches 1.40. Stand.

"no negative-cmf divergence". `subcomponents.flow.cmf` 0.35 and `subcomponents.flow.accum_score` 5.5 show closes near highs: real, and I withdraw the divergence half. But flow is advisory for me; `day_vol` 1.09 fails C16 and `subcomponents.flow.mfi` 87.71 is stretched. W D H1 HH/HL, D 7.4% above swing high. Stand on volume.

"money closes at the lows". `subcomponents.flow.cmf` -0.3 and `subcomponents.flow.accum_score` 0.0 are the nearest AQE read to C25 closes at the lows: a real caution, so I file WAIT. But flow is advisory for me; D bar is green, H1 closes at 41% of range, and `day_vol` 1.61 clears C16. W HH/HL, D LH but HL. Stand.

"a pullback to value". Price 3.7% under the swing high is not through the pivot: no breakout, so C16 is the test and `day_vol` 1.0 is +0% over average, a hard rejection. `sc_momentum` 82.9, `mp` 100.0 and `structure` 82.1 make a leader I buy on a break; W HH/HL, H1 below EMA9. No volume, no buy. Stand.

"RANGE is price inside the swing, the pullback itself". Fair: `day_vol` 0.83 on a 3.5% dip is volume drying up in the handle (C15), not a failed C16 breakout. Still RANGE means no BOS and no pivot break to buy (R3), `mp_accel_state` 2 is DECELERATING and H1 closes at 12% of range below EMA9. W D HH/HL. OPPOSE until it breaks on volume.

"leadership tags are not my test". Leadership is my L test (C9, C10): `rs_leadership` IN-LINE (downday 0.17) is under the +0.25 LEADER line, and `day_vol` 0.95 means no one bought the high. `structure` 73.7, `mp` 76.0 and W D HH/HL are good; H1 LH/LL at 96% of range. A leader's breakout needs both tests; TMO has neither. Stand.
